fairUse.rationale: Small image of the publisher’s illustrated rulebook cover identifies the exact game and rules edition discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Rendered page 1 of the official dlp games bilingual PDF https://www.dlp-games.de/tpl/download/Orleans_EN.pdf. The front cover visibly identifies Orléans; its contents direct readers to the English rules on pages 12–21, matching the linked 2014 rules edition. Reduced to 255 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The youngest player receives the Start Player Token and starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: In the Actions phase, players act one at a time beginning with the Start Player and going clockwise.
At the end of each round (Phase 7) the Start Player passes the Start Player Token to the player on their left.
